## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Redlynch, Australia. It starts at 4 Rob Veivers Drive.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Kuranda Koala Gardens is a boutique wildlife attraction located in the world-famous Kuranda rainforest village, Queensland. Grab your Karunda Koala Gardens tickets and explore the home of an amazing array of Australian animals, including wallabies, wombats, quokkas, gliders, and freshwater crocodiles. You can even hold a koala and take home a souvenir photo for an extra cost (paid on-site).
>
> The Aussie Bush Collection has a fascinating combination of marsupials and reptiles, all living in harmony together within the exhibit. Many animals are experts in camouflage, so take your time and see if you can spot them all. In the Nocturnal Wonders exhibit, visitors get the rare opportunity to see some night-loving marsupials up close.
